#2 - Drifting through autumn - Lyric: 

Your voice drifted in like the wind

Lingering long upon the falling leaves

The moment that you called out my name

My whole season seemed to change its color

I tucked this feeling away in a drawer

Keeping it quiet in sleep

With the folded page I was hiding

Keeps unfolding in the autumn breeze

As I turn my face away

Trying to hide my blushing cheeks

But even this trembling gaze

Was something I couldn't conceal

In the instant our eyes met, even the leaves stood still

The wind seemed to pause a moment, even my breath grew careful

With just one silent glance, did you already know

I'm slowly being dyed in color by this autumn that is you

Even when I walk past, pretending it's nothing

One piece of your laughter stops me still

The glance I let slip, pretending not to see

Has somehow started following you

At night, I count you like stars

Softly repeating your name to myself

Even carried on the cool night air

This longing stays warm inside me

So little by little, I step closer to your side

Even clumsy, if it's real, I'll quietly let it show

In the instant our eyes met, even the leaves stood still

The wind seemed to pause a moment, even my breath grew careful

With just one silent glance, did you already know

I'm slowly being dyed in color by this autumn that is you

Somewhere, are you also feeling this same tremble?

Even if it's a foolish thought, a smile keeps spreading on my face

I want to hold onto this moment before it falls like the autumn leaves

I want to gently keep this feeling from ever fading

I'll step closer, carefully

So you won't be startled

Slowly, in a quiet voice

I'll let my heart be known

Even if the words come out clumsy

Sincerity will reach you

I love this moment now

Inside this autumn that is you

Your voice drifting in like the wind

I find myself listening to it every day

With this heart dyed like the falling leaves

[Cold Open]
Should I cross over today
Or will tomorrow be too late
The words I kept folding away
keep fluttering in the wind

[Verse 1]
I stand myself before the mirror,
rehearsing sentences again and again
But standing before you, they scatter
and vanish like falling leaves

[Verse 2]
The words rise to my throat
then I swallow them and turn away
Even today, when I promised myself I'd be fine,
leaves the same shadow behind

[Chorus]
It's just one step away,
so why does the wind blow so hard between us
Even if my heart trembles like a leaf,
I want to cross over today
It's okay to be clumsy,
it's okay to shake
I'll take courage and let myself be dyed by you
I'll let this feeling go

[Verse 3]
Same bus stop, same season,
knowing I'll run into you
I look away at nothing in particular,
then gather up regret on my way home

[Chorus]
It's just one step away,
so why does the wind blow so hard between us
Even if my heart trembles like a leaf,
I want to cross over today
It's okay to be clumsy,
it's okay to shake
I'll take courage and let myself be dyed by you
I'll let this feeling go

[Bridge]
Yes, today's the day
I won't fold it away anymore
Just stay right where you are
because I'll be the one to cross over
I take a deep breath of the wind,
straighten my shoulders and walk
because if not now, this season
might drift too far away

[Final Chorus]
One step, two steps, crossing over
I'll let hesitation drift away like fallen leaves
Even as my heart gets dyed with color,
I won't let this moment go
It's okay to be clumsy, because it's real
It's okay to shake, because it's real
I'll gather my courage and call out to you
"Hey, want to take a walk?"

[Outro]
I finally crossed over,
and now the wind feels calm at last
I didn't know one step could mean this much
